decisions.rationale: The complete discourse expression directly attests now and introduces the object topic. No separate demonstrative or locative exponent is invented.
The complete technical term directly attests killing. Its SROG life member is not assigned the separate life in the following definition.
The complete genitive relates object to killing and is realized for in this local definition.
GZHI directly supports object in the four-part action analysis; unrelated mined names do not guide this occurrence.
This independent SROG supplies life in the definition of a sentient being, not a member of the earlier killing compound.
The complete possessive construction expresses being endowed with life. With realizes that relation; anything is the English generalizing expansion and remains outside.
The complete technical head directly attests sentient being. The colon introduces the explanatory life phrase; no separate being member is forced.
The complete agent noun directly attests murderer and names the person performing the act.
The complete reflexive directly attests himself, here the victim identical with the murderer.
This separate killing verb owns murdering in the reflexive condition. The English is is supplied progressive support.
NA marks the condition rendered when. It is not the unrelated later locative LA or an English completion condition.
The complete technical term directly attests undertaking, the stage whose wrong deed exists in self-killing.
SDIG PA directly attests wrong deed; the English article and the relation of to undertaking remain outside the lexical head.
YOD supplies the existence assertion there is in the undertaking clause.
This second KYI is the contrastive connector but between existence of undertaking wrong and absence of completion. It is not the earlier English but introducing the whole explanation.
The complete stage name directly attests completion. English one resumes wrong deed and has no separate source noun here.

The complete negative-existence predicate is represented by not with an elliptical one of completion. Do not invent a wrong-deed exponent for that English one or detach the predicate from the completion contrast.

The full honorific intentional/allusive construction is rendered referring in the explanation of the citation. Exact DGONGS NAS has no HGM gloss; reference abhipretya/saṃdhāya and the complete local clause support this contextual phrase, not a new attested gloss.

The exact standalone glossary title directly attests the levels of practitioners. The unified title variant grouped under actual level is separate evidence and does not replace the exact title reading.
The complete SA/Levels member is unique inside the title and directly attests levels. No separate Practitioners member is inferred solely from reference Yogachara.
The complete noun directly attests living being in the quotation; it is distinct from the earlier SEMS CAN/sentient being.
The complete other-person expression supports another in the quotation and is not moved to himself in the explanation.
The honorific citation verb directly supports state. Does is English auxiliary support and remains outside.
